newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh buys 25,000 T of sugar at $338.75/tonne.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh buys 25,000 T of sugar at $338.75/tonne.

text.p: State-owned Bangladesh Sugar and Food Industries Corporation said on Monday that it bought 25,000 tonnes of white sugar at $338.75 per tonne cost and freight (C&F).
The sugar is for shipment in July-August.
Corporation officials said Jeddah-based Supreme Global Incorporated won the deal during international bidding on June 12.
The first cargo of 12,500 tonnes should reach Bangladesh by July 24 and the rest by August 8, the officials said.
